about.title: Half Moon Bay Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Half Moon Bay is a small coastal town of about 12,657 people, and when a family here loses someone suddenly, the absence is felt across town. Public records for 2025 show 32 injury collisions and 45 people hurt on Half Moon Bay's roads, with no traffic deaths recorded that year. That is welcome news, but wrongful death claims arise from far more than car crashes: a fall at a rental property, a medical error, a defective product, or an incident on a job site can all leave a family with the same questions. California law gives certain relatives, a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then specific dependents and heirs, the right to bring a civil claim, generally within two years of the date of death. The claim can seek funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. LawProactive is not a law firm; we connect San Mateo County families, free of charge, with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency.

whyChoose.title: What a Half Moon Bay Family Should Know Before Filing

items.title: Only certain relatives can bring the claim
items.desc: California puts a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children at the front of the line, with specific dependents and heirs eligible in other situations. An attorney can sort out who in your family has standing before anything is filed.

items.title: The clock is usually two years, sometimes far less
items.desc: Most wrongful death actions must be filed within two years of the date of death. If a city, county, or state agency such as Caltrans may be responsible, a much shorter government claim deadline applies first.

items.title: The claim covers real and intangible losses
items.desc: Recoverable losses include funeral and burial expenses, the income and support the person would have contributed, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. This is a civil matter, separate from any criminal charges the district attorney may pursue.

items.question: My relative was killed in a crash on Highway 1 near Half Moon Bay. Does it matter that the road is a state route?
items.answer: It can. Rt 1, N Cabrillo Highway, and San Mateo Road account for a large share of the collisions reported in Half Moon Bay, and SR-1 is maintained by the state. If road design or maintenance played any part, a government claim must typically be presented within months, not years, so it is worth speaking with an attorney quickly even while you are still grieving.

items.question: The driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to end?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action that runs on its own track, and the two-year deadline keeps running regardless of what happens in criminal court. Many families pursue both at once, and evidence gathered by police or prosecutors can sometimes support the civil case.

items.question: What does it cost to use LawProactive and then hire an attorney?
items.answer: Our connection service is free, and we are not a law firm. The independent attorneys in our network handle wrongful death cases on contingency, meaning they are paid a percentage only if there is a recovery. If there is no recovery, you owe no attorney fee.
